# orchestrator endpoint inventory — generated by scripts/check_endpoint_auth.py
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Regenerate with `python scripts/check_endpoint_auth.py --write`.
#
# SCOPE: declared mounted /api, /auth and /wopi routes, including all literal
# HTTP methods and WS. Router constructor/include prefixes are composed;
# unmounted routers and framework-generated docs/OpenAPI routes are excluded.
# Other mounted paths are reported separately; unsupported composition fails.
# Gate labels are static source evidence, not authorization/control-flow proof.
#
# Classifications:
#   gated:<gate>           — protected by a require_* / user_can_access_* helper
#   admin:<gate>           — admin-only; the fleet-scoped variant also
#                            rejects project-scoped MCP admins
#   internal:<helper>      — authenticated non-user service boundary
#   public:<reason>        — opt-out via `# nosec: public <reason>` on line above decorator
#   unscoped               — no gate detected; CI snapshot test will fail
